titleEnglish: Kamle Wale Muhammad Ton Sadqay — Traditional

verses.ar:
Kamle Wale Muhammad Ton Sadqay Mein Jan
Jaynain Aakay Ghareeban Dee Baan Par Laee
Meree Baksheesh Waseela Muhammad Da Nan
verses.en:
I give my life in devotion to Muhammad — the one of the black shawl
Who came and took hold of the hand of the helpless
My salvation is through the intercession of Muhammad

verses.ar:
Kamle Wale Muhammad Ton Sadqay Mein Jan

verses.en:
I give my life in devotion to Muhammad — the one of the black shawl
Who came and took hold of the hand of the helpless

verses.ar:
Oday Wajon Koi Dunya Tey Pyara Naheen
Oday Warga Koi Jag Tey Sahara Naheen
Jay Na Honday Muhammad Na Honda Jahan
verses.en:
Because of him there is nothing more beloved in this world
There is no support in the world like his
If Muhammad had not been, this world would not have been

verses.ar:
Dasso gairan ch roya te kehna layi
Paida sohna je hoya te kehna layi
Kyon ni mangde tussi kali kamli di chchan
Jehne aake gareeban di bahn phad layi
verses.en:
Tell me — how can one weep in the presence of strangers?
If a beautiful one is born, what is there to say?
Why do you not seek the shade of the black shawl
Of the one who came and took the helpless by the hand?

verses.ar:
Naal ungli ishare de chann todeya
Gaya suraj agan wal pichchan modeya
Kalma sohne Muhammad da padheya butan
Jehne aake gareeban di bahn phad layi
verses.en:
With the gesture of a finger he split the moon
The sun turned its back and headed towards fire
Idols themselves recited the beautiful Kalima of Muhammad
Who came and took the helpless by the hand

verses.ar:
Laya Badooan Noon Seenay Kamaal Hoya
Koi Habshee To Hazrat Bilal Hoya
Aeye Dar Tey Sawali Noo Kitee Naeen Na
Jaynain Aakay Ghareeban Dee Baan Par Laee
verses.en:
He drew the Bedouins to his chest — what a miracle that was
A man of Abyssinia became Sayyiduna Bilal
No supplicant at his door was ever turned away
Who came and took hold of the hand of the helpless

verses.ar:
Weree Patar We Maran Tey Hasday Rahe
Fir Wee Rah-E-Khuda Sab Noon Dasday Rahe
Baree Siftanch Parya Aeye Saara Quran
verses.en:
Even as enemies tried to kill him, he smiled
Still he showed everyone the way of God
The entire Quran is filled with his praises
